text: dsh-chat-log 是面向 DSH Web 的会话记录导出插件，可把会话整理成可读的嵌套聊天 JSON。它提供 /chat 命令，并在会话页眉添加 Chat log 下载按钮。插件以权威消息折叠流式文本、推理和工具调用片段，生成 dsh-chat.v1 格式的轮次、步骤与工具结果，同时保留其他事件并提供片段核对报告。可指定会话 ID 和输出目录，也可从浏览器下载。适合需要归档、阅读或处理 DSH 会话记录的用户；需要 DSH Web 的会话服务及 Node.js 22.15 或更高版本。

dsh-chat-log exports DSH Web session logs as nested chat JSON through /chat or a session header button. It organizes messages into turns, steps, and tool results, retains other events, and compares stream fragments with authoritative messages. Requires DSH session services and Node.js 22.15+.

dsh-chat-log 的功能「会话转聊天树」：把 JSONL 会话事件整理为 dsh-chat.v1 聊天树。按轮次和步骤汇集用户消息、助手内容及工具调用结果。
dsh-chat-log 的功能「导出会话」：使用 /chat 命令导出当前或指定会话，可通过 --out 选择保存目录，并返回写入路径。
dsh-chat-log 的功能「网页下载」：会话页眉提供 Chat log 按钮，先检查下载接口，再交由浏览器下载管理器保存 JSON 文件。
dsh-chat-log 的功能「片段核对」：比较流式文本、推理和工具参数片段与权威消息折叠，并在报告中标记比较是否一致。
dsh-chat-log 使用前须知：页眉按钮依赖手动为 dsh-host-apiproxy 打补丁，且 DSH 升级可能覆盖该修改；/chat 命令无需此补丁。
dsh-chat-log 使用前须知：网页下载和命令导出都要求持久化服务能读取会话原始日志；缺少该能力时网页接口无法提供导出。

dsh-chat-log README · dsh-chat-log：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Turn a DSH session log into a **clean chat log**: streaming chunk fragments are folded into normal messages, and **everything else is kept verbatim**. Download it with one click next to the official "Session log" ZIP button, or via the `/chat` command.

dsh-chat-log README · Why：The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export` downloads a ZIP of the raw log: `session.jsonl` (or multi-frame zstd), where **over 80% of the lines are token-level streaming fragments** (`assistant/chunk`, `reasoning-chunks`, `text-chunks`, `tool-call-chunks`). Reading or reusing that log means wading through thousands of fragment lines.

dsh-chat-log README · Why：`dsh-chat-log` builds a readable chat view from the **authoritative folded events** (`user/message`, `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`), and keeps every other event (permissions, approvals, request context, lifecycle) verbatim in `events`.

dsh-chat-log README · Why：> A note on fidelity: fragment deltas occasionally lose characters against the authoritative fold (observed: a missing closing quote in a tool-call argument). This plugin **always trusts the authoritative fold** and reports the comparison result in `report`.

dsh-chat-log README · Features：| | official `/export` | this plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Output | raw-log ZIP (browser download) | **clean nested chat JSON** (`dsh-chat.v1`) |
| Streaming fragments | shipped as-is (80%+ of lines) | **folded into complete messages** |
| Everything else | mixed into the archive | **verbatim in `events`** (nothing dropped) |
| Download | ZIP only | **direct `.json` download** (same HEAD-preflight pattern) |
| Headless | ✗ | **`/chat` command** (zero tokens, human-command plane) |
| Verification | — | fragment↔fold comparison report |

dsh-chat-log README · Features：- **Zero runtime dependencies**, single pure-data core (`lib/fold.js`) — no zstd, no zip, no server.
- **Nothing is deleted**: every non-fragment event survives byte-identical; unverifiable fragment steps fall back to keeping raw events.
- **Token effect: zero.** `/chat` stays on the human-command plane; results never enter model history.

dsh-chat-log README · Requirements：- DSH Web (`dsh web`) profile with Node **≥ 22.15**
- `commands` / `sessionPersistence` / `sessions` services (mounted by the shipped profiles)
dsh-chat-log README · Install：```bash
dsh-chat-log README · from npm (recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-log
dsh-chat-log README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:YupegLV/dsh-chat-log

dsh-chat-log README · local (development / self-hosting)：dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/dsh-chat-log
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards.

dsh-chat-log README · ⚠️ Browser download needs one host patch (idempotent)：The "Chat log" button's **direct browser download** relies on a host download endpoint `/api/session.chat`, hosted in `dsh-host-apiproxy` — third-party plugins cannot register their own `/api/*` routes. After install, run once:

```bash
node node_modules/dsh-chat-log/scripts/patch-apiproxy.mjs
section: ⚠️ Browser download needs one host patch (idempotent)

dsh-chat-log README · or from the plugin checkout: node scripts/patch-apiproxy.mjs：```

The script is idempotent (safe to re-run; backs up the original file automatically). **Re-run after every DSH upgrade** (a fresh `dsh-host-apiproxy` overwrites the patch).

> Without the patch: the button fails silently (no status text), but the `/chat` command (writes to `dsh-chats/`) always works.
section: or from the plugin checkout: node scripts/patch-apiproxy.mjs

dsh-chat-log README · Usage：| Entry | Description |
|---|---|
| `/chat` | Export the **current** session → `<session-cwd>/dsh-chats/chat-<id8>-<timestamp>.json`, echoes the absolute path |
| `/chat --id <sessionId>` | Export a specific session |
| `/chat --out <dir>` | Custom output directory |
| **Chat log** button (session header) | Beside the official "Session log" ZIP button; HEAD-preflights then downloads `dsh-chat-<session-id>.json` through the browser download manager (needs the host patch above) |

dsh-chat-log README · Output format (`dsh-chat.v1`)：```jsonc
{
  "schema": "dsh-chat.v1",
  "session": { "id": "...", "createdAt": 1787625016270, "cwd": "...", "agentPreset": "standard", "title": "..." },
  "model": { "provider": "deepseek-official", "model": "...", "reasoningEffort": "max", "maxTokens": 256000 },

dsh-chat-log README · Nothing dropped guarantee：- `events` = every raw event **except** the stream fragments, byte-identical, in original order (verified at export: count **and** per-line identity).
- Fragment content is fully carried by the authoritative folds (every fragment step must have a matching `assistant/message`; steps without one keep their raw fragments in `events`).
- The export includes a `report`: total events, folded fragments/steps, kept events, fragment↔fold comparison.

dsh-chat-log README · Known limitations：- Requires a `sessionPersistence` backend exposing raw artifacts (JSONL backend: yes; SQLite: no — same as the official ZIP export).
- Output is pretty-printed JSON; roughly 1.2× the raw log size (authoritative folds + full `events`), ~30% if you truncate tool results.
- Direct browser download depends on the idempotent `dsh-host-apiproxy` patch (see Install; `/chat` writing to disk does not).
